WITH
cirrhosis AS (
  SELECT descendant_concept_id AS concept_id
  FROM omop.concept_ancestor
  WHERE ancestor_concept_id = 4064161
),
nsbb_drugs AS (
  SELECT descendant_concept_id AS concept_id
  FROM omop.concept_ancestor
  WHERE ancestor_concept_id IN (1353766,1313200,1346823,902427) -- propranolol, nadolol, carvedilol, timolol
),
any_bb_drugs AS (
  SELECT descendant_concept_id AS concept_id
  FROM omop.concept_ancestor
  WHERE ancestor_concept_id IN (1319998,1314002,1322081,1338005,1346823,1386957,1307046,1313200,1314577,1345858,1353766,1370109,902427)
),
variceal_bleed AS (
  SELECT descendant_concept_id AS concept_id
  FROM omop.concept_ancestor
  WHERE ancestor_concept_id = 28779 -- bleeding esophageal varices
),
hyp_syn AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT descendant_concept_id AS concept_id
  FROM omop.concept_ancestor
  WHERE ancestor_concept_id IN (135360,4206148,4285144,319041,4112334,4327471,4120275,4240219,4162208)
),
outpatient_visits AS (
  SELECT visit_occurrence_id, person_id, visit_start_date
  FROM omop.visit_occurrence
  WHERE visit_concept_id IN (9202,581477,8940,8756,5084,600074762,600074764,600074761)
),
indexed AS (
  SELECT co.person_id, MIN(co.condition_start_date) AS index_date
  FROM omop.condition_occurrence co
  JOIN cirrhosis c ON c.concept_id = co.condition_concept_id
  JOIN outpatient_visits v ON v.visit_occurrence_id = co.visit_occurrence_id
  JOIN omop.observation_period op ON op.person_id = co.person_id
    AND op.observation_period_start_date <= DATEADD(day,-365,co.condition_start_date)
    AND op.observation_period_end_date >= DATEADD(day,365,co.condition_start_date)
  GROUP BY co.person_id
),
classified AS (
  SELECT i.person_id, i.index_date,
    CASE WHEN EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM omop.drug_exposure de
      JOIN nsbb_drugs nd ON nd.concept_id = de.drug_concept_id
      WHERE de.person_id = i.person_id
        AND de.drug_exposure_start_date <= DATEADD(day,30,i.index_date)
        AND COALESCE(de.drug_exposure_end_date, de.drug_exposure_start_date) >= DATEADD(day,-30,i.index_date)
    ) THEN 'NSBB'
    WHEN NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM omop.drug_exposure de
      JOIN any_bb_drugs bd ON bd.concept_id = de.drug_concept_id
      WHERE de.person_id = i.person_id
        AND de.drug_exposure_start_date <= DATEADD(day,365,i.index_date)
        AND COALESCE(de.drug_exposure_end_date, de.drug_exposure_start_date) >= DATEADD(day,-30,i.index_date)
    ) THEN 'No beta-blocker'
    ELSE 'Other/selective beta-blocker'
    END AS exposure_group
  FROM indexed i
),
outcomes AS (
  SELECT c.person_id, c.exposure_group,
    MAX(CASE WHEN vb.condition_occurrence_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS variceal_hemorrhage_12m,
    MAX(CASE WHEN hs.condition_occurrence_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS hypotension_syncope_12m
  FROM classified c
  LEFT JOIN omop.condition_occurrence vb
    ON vb.person_id = c.person_id
    AND vb.condition_start_date > c.index_date
    AND vb.condition_start_date <= DATEADD(day,365,c.index_date)
    AND vb.condition_concept_id IN (SELECT concept_id FROM variceal_bleed)
  LEFT JOIN omop.condition_occurrence hs
    ON hs.person_id = c.person_id
    AND hs.condition_start_date > c.index_date
    AND hs.condition_start_date <= DATEADD(day,365,c.index_date)
    AND hs.condition_concept_id IN (SELECT concept_id FROM hyp_syn)
  WHERE c.exposure_group IN ('NSBB','No beta-blocker')
  GROUP BY c.person_id, c.exposure_group
)
SELECT exposure_group,
  COUNT(*) AS patients,
  SUM(variceal_hemorrhage_12m) AS variceal_hemorrhage_events,
  CAST(100.0*SUM(variceal_hemorrhage_12m)/COUNT(*) AS DECIMAL(6,2)) AS variceal_hemorrhage_rate_pct,
  SUM(hypotension_syncope_12m) AS hypotension_syncope_events,
  CAST(100.0*SUM(hypotension_syncope_12m)/COUNT(*) AS DECIMAL(6,2)) AS hypotension_syncope_rate_pct
FROM outcomes
GROUP BY exposure_group
ORDER BY exposure_group;

Using OMOP clinical records, I estimated a cirrhosis outpatient cohort with 12 months of prior and follow-up observation.

| Exposure group | Patients | Variceal hemorrhage within 12 mo | Rate | Hypotension/syncope within 12 mo | Rate |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| Non-selective beta-blocker | 1,068 | 158 | 14.79% | 35 | 3.28% |
| No beta-blocker | 14,657 | 412 | 2.81% | 210 | 1.43% |

Definitions used:
- Cirrhosis: descendants of SNOMED `4064161` “Cirrhosis of liver”
- Outpatient index: cirrhosis diagnosis tied to outpatient/office/hospital outpatient visit concepts
- NSBB: propranolol, nadolol, carvedilol, timolol exposure overlapping ±30 days around index
- No beta-blocker: no common beta-blocker exposure from 30 days before through 365 days after index
- Variceal hemorrhage: descendants of SNOMED `28779` “Bleeding esophageal varices”
- Hypotension/syncope: syncope and hypotension-related SNOMED descendants

Interpretation caveat: this is an unadjusted descriptive rate comparison. The higher variceal hemorrhage rate in the NSBB group likely reflects confounding by indication/severity, since NSBBs are preferentially prescribed to patients with known/high-risk portal hypertension or varices.
